# Generated by Claude Fable 5 (Anthropic)
AWSIM (Unity) + Autoware e2e_simulator under FISH — setup & findings (2026-08-17)
=================================================================================

Pieces
------
  AWSIM binary + Shinjuku map : image autoware-awsim-fish:latest (April 2026, OLD FISH,
                                no fishwait patches) — used ONLY to run the Unity binary
                                (/root/AWSIM-Demo-Lightweight, AWSIM-Demo v2.0.1) in a
                                fresh --rm container; its FISH never starts.
  Shinjuku map on host        : ~/autoware_map/Shinjuku-Map/map (lanelet2_map.osm +
                                pointcloud_map.pcd, extracted from the image once).
  Autoware                    : autoware-dev-trt-a1000-fishwait5 + current fish_interfere
                                (container_install route), sensor_model:=awsim_sensor_kit,
                                e2e_simulator.launch.xml, replay_rosbag=false, per_instance=true,
                                rmw_cyclonedds_cpp, no Cyclone XML (see autoware_dds_settings.txt).
  Both containers --net host, ROS_DOMAIN_ID 0; AWSIM ↔ Autoware over lo multicast, 10 Hz lidar.

VRAM (RTX A1000 laptop, 4 GB) — the decisive constraint
--------------------------------------------------------
  AWSIM windowed (any -screen-quality/-screen-width)  : 3.68–3.72 GB  → Autoware CUDA OOM
      (occupancy_grid_map_node failed to load → occupancy_grid_based_outlier_filter has no
       map → /perception/obstacle_segmentation/pointcloud never published → behavior planner
       publishes no trajectory → autonomous mode "not available"; localization/NDT and
       route setting still worked).
  AWSIM -batchmode -nographics                        : ~0.48 GB     → 3.2 GB left for Autoware
      Lidar (RGL, CUDA/OptiX) keeps publishing at 10 Hz with a correct row_step; camera
      sensor is dead (traffic-light recognition disabled on the Autoware side anyway).
  JSON config (sample-config.json) has no sensor toggles: TimeScale, TimeSourceType,
  RandomTrafficSeed, MaxVehicleCount, LogitechG29Settings, EgoVehicleSettings, EgoPose only.
  MaxVehicleCount=0 makes TrafficSimulator throw a NullReferenceException every FixedUpdate
  (log spam, otherwise harmless) — use ≥1.

Autoware side flags used
------------------------
  use_empty_dynamic_object_publisher:=true   (no centerpoint / TRT → saves VRAM)
  use_traffic_light_recognition:=false       (no yolox / classifier)
  rviz:=false
  Known warning: perception.obstacle_segmentation.crop_box_filter "Invalid PointCloud:
  row_step mismatch … Got: 0" on /sensing/lidar/concatenated/pointcloud (relay of
  /sensing/lidar/top/pointcloud_before_sync; single-lidar kit, no concat node). WARN only
  in this build; AWSIM's raw cloud has the correct row_step, so a node in the sensing
  preprocessing chain zeroes it. Not fixed.

Goal injection (no rviz)
------------------------
  1. wait for /api/routing/set_route_points, then let FISH stabilise (~60 s)
  2. ros2 service call /api/localization/initialize … "{}"  (GNSS auto-init from AWSIM)
     → /api/localization/initialization_state state=3 within ~15 s
  3. goal candidates computed from lanelet2_map.osm (lanelets 100–250 m ahead of the
     EgoPose in sample-config.json, same heading preferred); first accepted:
     lanelet 273  x=81470.167 y=49967.151 z=41.743 (map frame)
     via /api/routing/set_route_points (allow_goal_modification: true) → routing state 2
  4. /api/operation_mode/change_to_autonomous until success (needs planning trajectory).
  Scripts: scratchpad run_autoware_awsim_r12.sh / r13.sh (job tmp: goal_cands.json,
  goal_calls.txt).

Follow-up r19–r21 (2026-08-17 night)
-------------------------------------
- Map: v2.0.0 release Shinjuku-Map.zip pcd is byte-identical (md5 8a1723af5122)
  to the one we had; only map_projector_info.yaml (MGRS 54SUE) was missing →
  copied. Map version is NOT the problem.
- Full AWSIM-Demo (non-Lightweight, host ~/AWSIM-Demo) behaves the same
  (nographics 478 MiB, NVTL ~2.2).
- -nographics KILLS THE EGO: TrafficSimulator/TrafficLight NullReferenceException
  every Update/FixedUpdate (44 830×) → gear stays PARK (22), commands ignored,
  GNSS/camera dead. Vehicle never moves even when Autoware engages (r19).
- WORKING RENDER PATH: Vulkan via Mesa lavapipe (CPU): mount host
  libvulkan_lvp.so + libLLVM-15 + lvp ICD, VK_ICD_FILENAMES=lavapipe,
  -batchmode -screen-width 320 -screen-height 240, NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all
  (RGL/OptiX needs it). Result: 0 NRE, GPU used only by RGL (446 MiB), lidar 10 Hz,
  IMU 30 Hz, /clock real-time (ratio 0.99), CPU ~300–400 %. GNSS/camera still
  not published (frame-rate-bound sensors; llvmpipe fps very low) → keep the
  explicit-pose init. Script: scripts/autoware_runs/start_awsim_lavapipe.sh
  [Lightweight|Full].
- Localization is the remaining blocker. Evidence:
    * NDT NVTL 2.0–2.25 whatever the init yaw; EKF yaw lands anywhere
      (0.32, 0.49, 1.29, 1.67, −1.39, −1.47, −2.75 across runs).
    * offline yaw sweep of one AWSIM scan against the pcd (voxel hash):
      max 19 % inliers @0.5 m, 45 % @1 m, flat over ±25° → weak match.
    * awsim_sensor_kit sensor_kit_calibration.yaml has velodyne_top_base_link
      yaw 1.575 (real-Velodyne convention). r21 set it to 0.0 (container-local):
      EKF yaw 0.49 ≈ lane heading 0.61 (config EulerAngles z=35°) — plausible
      fix for yaw — but NVTL dropped to ~2.0 and position drifted 2–3 m →
      start_planner "Not found safe pull out path" → stop path, gear PARK.
  Hypotheses left: (i) v2 lidar frame/extrinsics differ from awsim_sensor_kit
  (compare with awsim_labs_sensor_kit), (ii) v2 scene geometry ≠ this pcd.
  Next cheap test: e2e with sensor_model:=awsim_labs_sensor_kit +
  vehicle_model:=awsim_labs_vehicle; or record one AWSIM scan and align it
  properly (ICP/NDT offline) to settle (i) vs (ii).
- Autoware side reached in r19/r21: init OK, route OK, autonomous engaged
  (mode 2, is_autonomous_mode_available true) — the whole API path works;
  the car does not move because planning outputs stop (traffic-signal
  unknown in r19 with empty TL publish; off-lane in r21).
